seltz.title: NUCC Taxonomy Code Reference | NewBizBot
seltz.snippet:
Data APICode References

Understanding healthcare provider taxonomy codes and how to query them in the NPI Providers dataset.

NUCC (National Uniform Claim Committee) taxonomy codes are 10-character alphanumeric codes used to classify healthcare providers by specialty. Every NPI provider record includes at least one taxonomy code as their primary specialty, making it the most useful filter for specialty-level analysis.

Taxonomy codes follow a hierarchical classification with three levels:


| Level | Description | Example |
| ----- | ----------- | ------- |
| **Provider Type** | Top-level grouping | Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians |
| **Classification** | Specialty area | Internal Medicine |
| **Specialization** | Sub-specialty (optional) | Cardiovascular Disease |

The code format is `XXXXXXXXXX` (10 characters, e.g., `207RC0000X`). The prefix identifies the provider type and specialty. There are **873 distinct taxonomy codes** in the dataset.

### Display Name

Each taxonomy code has a human-readable `display_name` derived from:

- Classification only (when no specialization): `"Internal Medicine"`
- Classification + specialization: `"Internal Medicine - Cardiovascular Disease"`

### URL Slug

Each code also has a URL-safe `slug` (e.g., `internal-medicine`, `cardiovascular-disease`) used in the NPI directory pages at `/npi/specialty/{slug}`.

Use the `primary_taxonomy_code` column on the `npi_providers` table:


```
# Exact taxonomy code
?primary_taxonomy_code=eq.207RC0000X

# Prefix match (all Internal Medicine subspecialties)
?primary_taxonomy_code=like.207R*

# Multiple specific codes
?primary_taxonomy_code=in.(207RC0000X,207RI0011X,207RG0100X)
```

### Combining with Other Filters


```
# Cardiologists in New York
?practice_state=eq.NY&primary_taxonomy_code=eq.207RC0000X&limit=20

# All physician specialties in Houston, TX
?practice_state=eq.TX&practice_city=eq.HOUSTON&primary_taxonomy_cod
